Annotation.String: This property shall represent the NVIDIA OEM properties for a EnvironmentMetrics resource.
This property shall represent the NVIDIA OEM properties for a EnvironmentMetrics resource.
This action is used to reset EDPp scaling percentage to a device default.
This action shall reset EDPp scaling percentage to a device default.
This action is used to clear the set point value of power limit control set by an OOB client.
This action shall clear the set point value of power limit control set by an OOB client.
The power mode setting.
This property shall contain the power mode setting for this resource.
The EDPp scaling percentage control.

This property shall contain EDPp (Electrical Design Point Peak) scaling percentage control for this resource. It allows users to query and control the programmable EDPp thresholds by specifying a percentage scaling value, without necessarily lowering the current power limit.
Maximum performance mode. This value shall indicate the GPU will operate unconstrained up to its maximum performance level.
Maximum efficiency mode. This value shall indicate the GPU will operate with optimized performance per watt.
Custom mode. This value shall indicate the GPU will operate with the power limit specified in the SetPoint property.
The desired set point control value of EDPp scaling percentage.

This property shall contain the desired set point control value of EDPp scaling percentage. This property may be written with the desired value of Persistency property. If Persistency property is absent on a PATCH operation, the default is false.
Indicates whether the desired set point control value will be retained over subsequent resets.

This property shall indicate whether the desired set point control value will be retained over subsequent resets, where a value `true` shall indicate that the set point control value is persistent after a device reset. If this property is absent on a PATCH operation for writing SetPoint property, the default is false.
The minimum allowable value for this control.
This property shall indicate the minimum allowable value of the SetPoint property for this control.
The maximum allowable value for this control.
This property shall indicate the maximum allowable value of the SetPoint property for this control.
This version was created to add `ClearOOBSetPoint` action.
Indicates whether a client can set the persistence of the desired power limit control value.

This property shall indicate whether a client can set the persistence of the desired power limit control value, where a value `true` shall indicate that the power limit control value will be persistent over subsequent resets. Use this property with a PATCH to write the SetPoint value in the PowerLimitWatts object.
The persistent power limit requested by the client, in watt units.
This property shall contain the persistent power limit requested by the client, in watt units. If no power limit request has been previously submitted, the value is `null` in responses.
The one-shot power limit requested by the client, in watt units.
This property shall contain the one-shot power limit requested by the client, in watt units. If no power limit request has been previously submitted, the value is `null` in responses.
The desired set point of the GPU base power control.

This property shall contain the desired set point control value for GPU base power. The units shall be watts (W). This is the baseline power allocation for the GPU before additional limits are applied.
The default set point of the GPU base power control.
This property shall contain the default set point control value for GPU base power. The units shall be watts (W).
The minimum possible setting for this control.
This property shall indicate the minimum possible value of the SetPoint property for this control. Services shall not accept values for SetPoint below this value. The units shall be watts (W).
The maximum possible setting for this control.
This property shall indicate the maximum possible value of the SetPoint property for this control. Services shall not accept values for SetPoint above this value. The units shall be watts (W).
Indicates whether the desired set point control value will be retained over subsequent resets.

This property shall indicate whether the desired set point control value will be retained over subsequent resets, where a value `true` shall indicate that the set point control value is persistent after a device reset.
The one-shot setpoint for GPU base power requested by the client, in watt units.
This property shall contain the one-shot power limit requested by the client, in watt units. If no power limit request has been previously submitted, the value is `null` in responses.
The persistent power limit requested by the client, in watt units.
This property shall contain the persistent power limit requested by the client, in watt units. If no power limit request has been previously submitted, the value is `null` in responses.
This property contains the GPU Base Power settings.

This property shall contain the GPU Base Power settings. It is similar to the PowerLimitWatts property. Base power is the allocation for the GPU, which may be augmented by unused power borrowed from CPUs and switches.
The GPU's view of the CPU power limit (W).
This property shall contain the GPU's view of the CPU power limit, in watt units. This value informs the GPU of the CPU power limit for the Power Steering use case.
The GPU's view of the Switch power limit (W).
This property shall contain the GPU's view of the Switch power limit, in watt units. This value informs the GPU of the Switch power limit for the Power Steering use case.
